findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司預期美國對鋼、鋁、銅及其衍生品課徵的 50% 關稅會對成本造成不利影響；新增關稅或他國報復性關稅可能對業務產生重大不利影響；並設有加州與德拉瓦的外貿區以遞延／避免關稅。
findings.excerpt: Prior tariffs imposed on steel and aluminum imports increased the cost of raw materials for our products and decreased the available supply, and, accordingly, we expect the 50% tariffs imposed on U.S. imports of steel, aluminum, copper, and subsequent derivative products to adversely impact our costs.

findings.claim: 10-K 地緣風險：中美貿易緊張可能影響二、三級次組件供應商的稀土與組件取得；產品組件主要由台灣供應。
findings.excerpt: Our products contain components which are supplied principally from Taiwan. As such, any disruption impacting Taiwan could adversely impact our ability to obtain these components and supply our customers with products.

findings.claim: MD&A：管理層指出中美貿易緊張與對所有貿易夥伴的關稅對供應鏈造成壓力，但至今未發生重大組件短缺，並以擴大供應商基礎、降低單一供應商依賴因應。
findings.excerpt: While we have not experienced any significant component shortages to date, such factors, as well as challenges we face as a result of our need to expand our capacity due to the growth of our business, have placed pressure on our supply chain.

note: 出口管制／實體清單搜尋未找到任何涉及 BE 的 2026 來源（none）；關稅面僅有 10-K 一手披露，搜尋摘要提及 2026-06 金屬 232 關稅部分衍生品由 25% 降至 15%，但未讀到原文且未指明 BE。
